profiles.description: A privacy pool that grows itself. Only shielded $HOODS earns: the 1% tax, buybacks and 75M genesis all stream to holders inside the hood. Liquidity is locked forever, the hook is immutable, and exits pay the stayers. Bigger hood, bigger crowd, better privacy.

RESTRICTED (XGME) pays its holders in GME, the tokenized GameStop share issued on Robinhood Chain.

The name comes from 28 January 2021, when retail brokerages set GameStop to position closing only. Holders could sell but could not buy, and the move happened without them. This is the one you can buy, and it pays you GameStop.

It has already paid. The first holder payment ran on 26 September 2026 and sent GME stock tokens straight to holder wallets, including wallets with no connection to the project. Nothing was claimed and nothing was staked. Transaction 0xb0d23da70772ff6db5e432c8474e52c12641b0297da8018f37e13d8f536d8fa7.

Every trade carries a 5% fee, split on chain by a fee splitter contract rather than by anyone's discretion:

60% buys GME and sends it straight to the wallets of everyone holding RESTRICTED at the time of payment. No claim button, no staking contract, no lockup, no minimum hold time.
15% buys GME that the token contract itself holds as backing. Any holder can burn their RESTRICTED to redeem a proportional share of it.
15% buys RESTRICTED on the open market and burns it.
5% to pool liquidity, 5% to the creator.

The distribution engine retains 7.5% of what it routes, which pays the on-chain cost of sending the payments.

RESTRICTED opened on the Bucket Shop launchpad on 25 September 2026 and graduated the same day into a public Uniswap V4 pool paired against USDG. Distribution ran through a public bonding curve open to anyone from the first block, with no presale and no private round. A 99% tax applied to buys in the first three seconds and then expired, which stops automated snipers accumulating supply before ordinary buyers can transact. The launchpad takes a permanent 0% fee from this token as its founding launch.

Holder concentration, stated plainly: total supply is 918,367,347 XGME and the creator wallet holds 388,105,700 of it, about 42 percent. Anyone can verify that on chain.

Every contract behind the token is source verified on the Robinhood Chain Blockscout explorer: the token, the bonding curve, the fee splitter and the liquidity lock.

Built by Bucket Labs LLC, which also operates Bucket Shop.

It is the Pepe you already know, in a Lincoln green cap with one red feather, a longbow and three arrows. He looks about as pleased with the outfit as you would expect.

TALIS is an onchain structured markets protocol built for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain.

TALIS lets the same underlying asset serve two different market views. Holders can earn premium by giving up a defined portion of their future upside, while traders with stronger conviction can buy concentrated exposure to that upside.

Each market operates through defined periods with transparent pricing, strike levels and onchain settlement. Instead of relying on traditional perpetual leverage, funding rates or liquidation mechanics, upside positions are backed by the underlying assets locked within the protocol.

For holders, TALIS creates a way to generate income from assets they already own. For traders, it creates a way to isolate and trade the part of a market move they actually want.

One asset. Different outcomes.

100% of protocol revenue buys back $TALIS.

Built on Robinhood Chain.
